root_cause.text: In smb2_get_ea(), the alignment memset after writing each EA entry is performed without checking if the remaining buffer space (buf_free_len) can accommodate the padding bytes, causing an out-of-bounds write when the EA value exactly fills the buffer.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states: "The bounds check on buf_free_len is performed before the value memcpy, but the alignment memset fires unconditionally afterward with no check on remaining space." The patch adds a bounds check before the memset: `if (buf_free_len < alignment_bytes) break;`.
